messages:
sam (pm): quick call — need a go/no-go on a seat-waiver promo for Starter tier. Partner B pushing for soft start.
maria (pricing): summarize the ask so we can scope risk.
elaine (sales): Partner B wants the first 60 days with no per-user minimum + a 2x burst credit top-up. They've committed to a joint marketing case if they convert.
jamal (eng): infra note: seat minima enforced at billing layer; we can short-circuit via a promo_uuid map to ignore seat checks for billing but need console visibility for CSMs. Manual change path is straightforward but not surfaced in UI.
kelly (finance): rough exposure: if they fully use burst, incremental cost could be ~$4k over two months. We can absorb for high-conv probability but need conversion trigger (e.g., >50% active user adoption) or minimum ARR.
maria (pricing): propose formal guardrails: duration_days=60, burst_multiplier=2, monthly_token_cap=120000. Also require conversion metric and CSM attestation for pilot lift.
sam (pm): proposed launch criteria: (1) Signed pilot addendum (2) Billing flag present (3) CSM playbook + console note (4) Auto-revoke at day 60 or on conversion.
elaine (sales): partner okay with auto-revoke. They're asking if SLA can be relaxed during pilot — no, they accept standard SLA.
jamal (eng): implementation options: A) manual provision via internal tool (ETA 1d + runbook), B) add admin API and console change (ETA 3 sprints). Also add monitoring if token cap approaches 80%.
kelly (finance): manual is fine for 1-2 pilots. We need a post-mortem cost report afterwards.
maria (pricing): add product rule: if we see more than 2 seat-waiver requests in a quarter, prioritize building admin promo UI.
sam (pm): decision: do we greenlight manual pilot?
elaine (sales): +1, we need momentum. Partner requests kickoff in 2 weeks.
jamal (eng): fine with manual. I'll prepare a runbook and a one-click admin checklist.
ops-bot: Jira created: "PROMO-SEATWAIVER-2834445678" assigned to sam (pm).
kelly (finance): will provide cost threshold and a fallback billing cadence if they exceed cap (ETA 2d).
maria (pricing): drafting pilot clause now; will include `exemption_policy` snippet:
```
exemption_policy {
  duration_days: 60
  burst_multiplier: 2
  monthly_token_cap: 120000
  auto_revoke: true
}
```
sam (pm): action items:
- elaine: collect partner projected MAU + expected token profile by Fri (2834445600)
- jamal: manual provision runbook + monitoring alert (ETA 1d)
- kelly: cost guardrail + post-pilot billing plan (ETA 2d)
- maria: pilot addendum draft + sample contract clause (ETA 3d)

sam (pm): any blockers?
jamal (eng): just need product access to create promo_uuid mappings.
maria (pricing): add clause that promo is revocable on suspected abuse and that standard pricing applies after revoke.
elaine (sales): noted. I'll make sure partner sees the conversion ask and marketing requirement.
sam (pm): ok let's run manual pilot. I'll follow up with calendar invite and link to the promo runbook when jamal posts it.
